text: It's become my regular place now. The staff are lovely and polite, the doctor is skilled and fun to chat with! 555

I learned about this place because someone recommended it. At first, I was hesitant to come because it had few reviews, but I had an urgent problem, so I had to come. My first impression was that the person who answered the phone gave me advice and spoke very well, so I decided to give it a try. My second impression was when I met the doctor and other assistants. Everyone was friendly and lovely. The doctor had a gentle touch and gave excellent advice. I used to be very afraid of the dentist, wondering why I hadn't seen this doctor before. I've only encountered harsh and heavy-handed doctors, so I was even more afraid. Anyone looking for a good dental clinic should open their minds to come here. You won't be disappointed.
